# Customer Success skill

Work with the existing UX and Analytics issues (#28, #41, #45) rather than rebuilding their modules. Propose measurable activation and support journeys, accessibility tests, churn hypotheses and user-feedback collection with explicit consent.

No unsolicited messages, monitoring of personal records, live deployment, or unaudited customer data transfers. Escalate evidence gaps and add a rollback path.
